scope: Read-only source audit of requirements 23,25,33,36,37; two bounded findings only. No source, shared ledger, backend, workflow, or browser-matrix edits.

findings.title: Preflight quality-state border is overridden by generic panel presentation
findings.source_confirmed_observation: Preflight details receives panel plus quality-ok or quality-warning. Early quality selectors define literal green/pink borders, but later .panel border-color has equal specificity and later source order; .panel:hover also forces neutral border. The border therefore cannot reliably communicate the existing quality class. Textual issue content remains present. This is a presentation inconsistency, not evidence that scheduling warnings or validation fail.
findings.safe_proposed_fix: Add narrowly scoped .quality-panel.quality-warning and .quality-panel.quality-ok rules after generic panel styles using semantic warning-border/success-border tokens, including deliberate hover handling. Retain exact content, class conditions, handlers, and workflow gates. Do not recolor scheduling severity logic.
required_tests: Render existing safe and unsafe preflight fixtures in light and dark themes; inspect computed border color before/after hover and keyboard focus.
Verify textual issues and included periods remain identical, native details remains keyboard operable, and no API or scheduling payload changes occur.
Check narrow 320px layout and forced-colors handling; retain semantic text independent of color.

findings.title: Source still contains multiple independently drawn icon conventions
findings.source_confirmed_observation: Shell close/menu icons use inline 24x24 stroked SVG with stroke-width 2, Limits warning uses independently authored 16x16 filled SVG, and Limits identity uses a font-rendered star. Existing icons are decorative and aria-hidden. This proves the one-family requirement is not yet fulfilled; it does not prove misalignment or accessibility failure at runtime.
findings.safe_proposed_fix: Inventory all icon usage first, then adopt a small local SVG helper or existing repository family for decorative identity/menu/warning icons. Preserve the current visible text, aria-hidden state, accessible names, clickable controls, and semantic warning text. Use scoped explicit icon boxes and shared optical sizing; do not replace meaningful text with icon-only controls.
required_tests: Capture shell and Limits icons at 320px and desktop in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, light/dark, checking baseline alignment and no font-dependent glyph variation.
Verify unchanged accessible names, focus order, touch-target dimensions and actual button outcomes.
Check CSP compatibility and offline operation with local SVG; do not introduce remote icon resources.

remaining_scope_notes: Royal navy framing and semantic theme/shadow tokens are present; no global visual consistency certification was attempted.
Uppercase rules still exist, but the inspected role/section labels alone do not establish a violation of the purposeful-short-label exception in requirement 33.
No browser tests, axe checks, pixel contrast measurements, or full icon inventory ran in this source-only audit.
No whole requirement is certified and no implementation status should be changed solely from this report.
